description: Render a portrait or scene image. Eligible ELITE/ULTIMATE users may use the shared monthly free-image allowance for covered models and qualities; otherwise users pay gold. Partners are billed from their wallet in USD. Choose a model via chargen_list_image_models (per-model costs, quality tiers, reference-image support). Returns request_id - poll with chargen_get_job. If the prompt is blocked by content moderation the response reports moderation_blocked: true and gold_charged: 0 (no gold was debited); the returned request_id never becomes pollable (chargen_get_job reports not_found).

campaign_entity_id.description: Optional: a tracked world-graph entity in campaign_id (chargen_list_entities). The finished image is attached to that entity automatically. User accounts only.

campaign_id.description: The campaign that holds campaign_entity_id (chargen_list_campaigns). Only used with campaign_entity_id. User accounts only.

model.description: Image model to use for rendering. Use chargen_list_image_models for per-model costs, quality tiers, and reference-image support.

prompt.description: What to draw, written for the chosen model: chargen_list_image_models gives each model's prompt_style and the rule for it. Nothing adds an art style or improves the wording, so say the subject, setting, medium or art style, lighting and framing yourself.

quality.description: Rendering quality tier - changes the gold cost on quality-priced models (see chargen_list_image_models for per-tier prices; GPT Image models default to Medium). Models without quality tiers ignore it. User accounts only.

reference_image_id.description: Optional id of one of the user's own CharGen images to use as the image-to-image reference (image_id values come from chargen_search_gallery or chargen_get_generation). The model must support reference input - see chargen_list_image_models. User accounts only.

reference_image_url.description: Alternative to reference_image_id: a direct http(s) URL to a .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.webp image to use as the reference. Prefer reference_image_id for CharGen images. User accounts only.

resolution.description: Output resolution tier. Flux 3 accepts 1k, 2k, or 4k and the gold cost changes (7, 17, 88). Ideogram V4.5 accepts 1k or 2k at the same gold cost. Ideogram V4.6 accepts 1k, 2k, or 4k. 1k and 2k share a price. 4k costs more, and Very Low cannot be 4k. MAI Image 2.7 is 10 gold at 1k and 19 at 2k. MAI Image 2.7 Flash is 4 at 1k and 6 at 2k. Nano Banana 2.1 accepts 1k, 2k, or 4k (6, 9, 19). Seedream 5.5 accepts 1k, 1.5k, or 2k (3, 3, 5; a reference image adds gold). Kling 4.0 Image accepts 2k, 4k, or 8k (9, 13, 22) and defaults to 2k. Default 1k. Other models reject this argument.
